# Vertical overlay: Energy

**Level:** CISA critical infrastructure sector (child of NAICS 22 Utilities)
**Primary industry for Cris Santos Company:** NAICS 486210 Pipeline Transportation of Natural Gas. Natural gas transmission pipeline operator.
**Primary system:** Pipeline SCADA and gas control system

## Regulators and sector risk management agency
SRMA: Department of Energy (DOE); FERC; NERC and Regional Entities; TSA (pipeline/LNG security); PHMSA (pipeline safety incl. SCADA control room management)

## Primary regulation for the gap analysis (P03)
**TSA Security Directive Pipeline-2021-02G**, TSA SD Pipeline-2021-02G, issued under 49 U.S.C. 114. Cris Santos Company operates a natural gas transmission pipeline in this vertical. The research for this sector recommends TSA SD Pipeline-2021-02G as the gap target for pipeline operators (NERC CIP applies to bulk electric system entities instead). The directive applies only to pipelines TSA has designated as critical and notified; confirm designation in step 1 of P03.
Source: https://www.tsa.gov/sites/default/files/signed_security_directive_pipeline-2021-02g_and_transmittal_memo_508c.pdf

## Sector context
- **Sensitive data:** CEII (18 CFR 388.113); BES Cyber System Information (CIP-011); SSI (49 CFR Part 1520) - TSA SD content and pipeline security info; Customer PII/usage data
- **Critical systems:** EMS/SCADA; ICCP links; Substation automation and protective relays; Generation DCS; Pipeline SCADA, compressor/pump station PLCs; LNG terminal DCS/SIS; Physical access control systems (PACS) and EACMS
- **Sector AI rules and guidance:** ; 
- **Assurance alternatives to SOC 2:** TSA pipeline security directive compliance reviews (for designated pipelines)
- **Scenario incident (P08):** Ransomware on business IT forcing precautionary pipeline shutdown
- **Scenario AI use case (P10):** Pipeline leak-detection anomaly model
